document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  press  on  through  the  interminable  landscape  of  the 
North Hanninah.

If you have the keyword INCHCAPE, go to 601. To scale a ridge, 
go to 469. To stick close to the river, go to 75. To hold a parallel 
course, go to 55. To thread through light woodland, go to 218. To 
penetrate deeper into the forest, go to 557.
